scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.runtime:check: node scripts/run.mjs server uv run python -m silverloop.runtime check
scripts.build: pnpm --dir client build && uv --directory server build --no-build-isolation
scripts.test:postgres: node scripts/run.mjs server uv run pytest tests/test_postgres_integration.py -m postgres
scripts.test:scenarios: node scripts/run.mjs server uv run python -m silverloop.scenarios ../scenarios
scripts.lint: uv --directory server run ruff check src tests
scripts.format: node client/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write . && uv --directory server run ruff format src tests
scripts.format:check: node client/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check . && uv --directory server run ruff format --check src tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir client typecheck && pnpm --dir e2e typecheck && uv --directory server run python -m compileall -q src tests && pnpm synthetic:typecheck
scripts.synthetic:typecheck: uv run --project server python -m compileall -q tools/synthetic-data/generate.py
scripts.seed: node scripts/run.mjs server uv run python -m silverloop.seed
scripts.migrate: node scripts/run.mjs server uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.demo:story: node scripts/run.mjs server uv run python -m silverloop.demo_story
scripts.demo:smoke: node scripts/run.mjs server uv run python -m silverloop.smoke
scripts.demo:supabase-smoke: node scripts/run.mjs server uv run python -m silverloop.supabase_smoke
